summary: Brother of John's 6th-great-grandmother Keturah (John's 6th-great-grand-uncle); twin of John; probably the 'James Tuttle' who signed the 1775 Articles of Association.
bio: Twin of John (b. 1753). Other siblings: twins Ezekiel & William (c.1754), Keturah (~1755), Samuel, Daniel. The 1775 Articles of Association in Cornwall Precinct were signed by 'Thomas Lamoureux' and 'James Tuttle'. His brother John (b. 1753) may be the 'Capt. Tuthill' on a 1788 committee (Eager 1846).
